title: Contentful CMA personal access token as a Bearer header value or the token member of the create response
summary: A synthetic opaque value after the Bearer scheme in a raw request and a quoted curl -H argument, and as the token member of a pretty-printed create-token response.
rationale: Contentful documents Authorization: Bearer <token> as the authentication form of the endpoint that creates a personal access token, and states that the token value is returned only once (contract claim creation-api-bearer-carrier-shown-once; the response member is the token member of its example response, claim reference-example-token-shape-differs). The page states no prefix, alphabet or length, and the current example shape (64 hexadecimal characters, no prefix) conflicts with the CFPAT- placeholders and the rule artifacts, so no shape is used: the value is flagged because of where it sits. The extent is the value only. The sys.redactedValue member is not asserted (open question redacted-value-member).

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, redact-secret#1228 Group C). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in an Authorization: Bearer header of a Contentful Content Management API request, or in the token member of the create-token response, is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Contentful documents the Bearer authentication form and a value returned only once (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: Creates a Personal Access Token with the specified scopes (content_management_read or content_management_manage). The token value is only returned once — copy and store it securely.
sources.locator: Create an access token, description under the example response

sources.supports: Bearer authentication of the form Bearer <token>, where token is your auth token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
